claim_summary: On \(X_m=\Delta_{[m]}^{(1,1,1,1,m-4)}\) the unique three-torsion module carries the \(S_4\times S_m\) product-sign character, and every nonidentity row-subgroup fixed-point space is an explicitly counted wedge of spheres.

integrity.scientific_provenance: Theorems cited directly; no independent validation claimed

scientific_limitations: Torsion uniqueness is imported from the full primary proof (Theorem 5.7) and its integral relative-chain presentation.
Results do not determine the free homology representation or an ambient equivariant homotopy splitting.
Finite numerical checks corroborate, but cannot certify, the uniform infinite-family argument.
Equivalent unindexed mathematics remains an originality risk.
title: Row-symmetry fixed points and the integral torsion character of a multiple chessboard family
